paraphrase.proposes: This track fixes four defects in the weekly model-guide update: the approval path moved by closeout, stale public HTML pages, a missing leak check, and a missing executable bit with wrong README wording. It adds a stable approval record beside the tools and a named refusal when that record is missing. It rebuilds index.html, real-work.html, and conditionally review.html through preview.sh and guide.ts, runs leak-check.ts before the commit, and stages only explicit paths. The weekly update runs under the first publish's standing site-push word, needs no new PM approval, and never pushes. Phase 2 runs the first weekly update on the next PM export with --docs and keeps the pilot gate deferred.

It never runs leak-check.ts, and its index mode is 100644, so the README command without bash cannot execute.
